category_title: High-achieving dyslexic students using deep-level comprehension strategies
scenario_title: Classroom instruction with heavy reading and note-taking demands
minimal_context: The student is reading an 891-word expository social studies text about socialization, norms, and sanctions to make notes on the most important information before a deadline.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read this 891-word text about socialization, norms, and sanctions by yourself and write down notes on the most important information before the deadline.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am trying to read it, but I am getting slowed down by having to cope with the difficult words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep reading and do your best to take notes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to make notes on the most important information, but working toward this deadline is making me stressed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to finish reading the text by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I feel that I don’t learn very well from merely reading a text by myself. I think it works just fine to talk about the topics, to discuss them, but doing this alone is too slow.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please read this 891-word text about socialization, norms, and sanctions by yourself and write down notes on the most important information before the deadline.

TUTOR: Try to finish reading the text by yourself.

STUDENT: I feel that I don’t learn very well from merely reading a text by myself. I think it works just fine to talk about the topics, to discuss them, but doing this alone is too slow.

task.content: Studying an 891-word expository social studies text about socialization, norms, and sanctions
task.learning_goal: Processing the material and making notes on the most important information

context.materials: Expository social studies text, blackboard, PowerPoint slides, transparencies
context.social_setting: Group or the class as a whole

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher presents information during lessons that requires rapid copying, or when reading text independently
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Slowed down during work, expressing that it takes too long to write down what is presented
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling stressed when working toward deadlines; feeling they do not learn well from merely reading by themselves
related_quotes: I feel that I don’t learn very well from merely reading a text by myself.

behavior_patterns.condition: When working with text and having to cope with difficult words
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Slowed reading pace, actively seeking help from teachers, remaining attentive but struggling to take notes quickly
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Appreciates when teachers understand their word-level reading difficulties
related_quotes: I think it works just fine to talk about the topics, to discuss them.
